verdict.rationale: telli's docs describe connecting an existing number and phone system over SIP trunk for both inbound and outbound calls, and an API endpoint that imports numbers from your own SIP trunk provider with custom termination settings. They also cover forwarding calls from your own provider or PBX, so you are not locked to bundled telephony. Missing for 10: explicit Twilio/Telnyx number import, detailed SIP configuration docs (codecs, auth, regions), independent or hands-on corroboration.
